decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot draws directly on the firm's in-house automation, formwork and control expertise, so it can interpret early results and refine the product through its own R&D.
Automatic de-shuttering fits closely with the firm's existing precast plant knowledge, and its own R&D lets it absorb customer feedback to improve the robot within a growing market.

The profile storage robot complements the shuttering robots and builds on the firm's material-handling and control capabilities, giving it learning value and integration benefits that justify keeping it.
Automatic shuttering is a core part of the firm's automated precast portfolio, and its related knowledge and engineering capacity position it well to develop the product commercially.
